About Lexicon Atlas

Philippe StuartFacebook profile ↗

The Sense graph displays the complete locally verified Open English WordNet 2025 release. The Full word view adds attached CMUdict, IPA, UniMorph, Wiktionary, and historical GCIDE records when present. Synthesis creates a ranked proposal from those records using transparent heuristics.

Source records stay separate. A shared spelling does not prove that definitions, pronunciations, forms, or derivations refer to the same sense.

Definitions and relations are lexical evidence. They do not resolve what a word means in a sentence and do not create Control Draft authority, rules, or axioms.

Related prototype: the anonymized, code-only NLP Development Suite is published in alia-june/xOSG-prototype ↗. Both repositories exclude dictionary payloads; locally installed lexical data remains separate.
